q.en: How long does bleeding usually last in one period?
q.hg: Ek period mein bleeding usually kitne din chalti hai?

options.en: A few hours
options.hg: Kuch ghante

options.en: 2 to 7 days
options.hg: 2 se 7 din

options.en: 10 to 14 days
options.hg: 10 se 14 din

options.en: A full month
options.hg: Poora mahina

explain.en: Bleeding for 2 to 7 days is typical. Bleeding that goes on for more than 7 days should be checked by a doctor.
explain.hg: 2 se 7 din bleeding typical hai. 7 din se zyada bleeding chale toh doctor ko dikhana chahiye.

q.en: What is the best way to keep the genital area clean during a period?
q.hg: Period mein genital area ko clean rakhne ka best tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Wash the outside (vulva) with plain water
options.hg: Bahar ke hisse (vulva) ko plain paani se dhona

options.en: Use a scented wash inside the vagina
options.hg: Vagina ke andar scented wash use karna

options.en: Add antiseptic liquid to the bath water
options.hg: Nahane ke paani mein antiseptic liquid milana

options.en: Avoid washing until the period ends
options.hg: Period khatam hone tak na dhona

explain.en: The vagina cleans itself from inside, so only the outer area needs plain water. Scented or antiseptic products can irritate the skin.
explain.hg: Vagina andar se khud ko clean rakhti hai, isliye sirf bahar ke area ko plain paani chahiye. Scented ya antiseptic products se skin irritate ho sakti hai.

q.en: What triggers an ovary to release an egg?
q.hg: Ovary se egg release hona kis cheez se trigger hota hai?

options.en: A fall in progesterone
options.hg: Progesterone ka girna

options.en: The first day of bleeding
options.hg: Bleeding ka pehla din

options.en: A sudden surge of LH
options.hg: LH ka achanak surge

options.en: Eating iron-rich food
options.hg: Iron-rich khana khana

explain.en: When estrogen peaks, the pituitary gland releases a surge of luteinising hormone (LH), and that surge causes ovulation.
explain.hg: Jab estrogen peak pe pahunchta hai, toh pituitary gland luteinising hormone (LH) ka surge release karti hai, aur isi se ovulation hota hai.

q.en: Meher, 16, has not had a period for four months. She has never had sex. What should she do?
q.hg: 16 saal ki Meher ko chaar mahine se period nahi aaya. Usne kabhi sex nahi kiya. Use kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Wait a year, since teenage cycles are irregular
options.hg: Ek saal wait kare, kyunki teenage cycles irregular hote hain

options.en: Take a friend's hormone tablets to bring the period on
options.hg: Period laane ke liye friend ki hormone tablets le le

options.en: Start a crash diet to reset her hormones
options.hg: Hormones theek karne ke liye crash diet start kar de

options.en: See a doctor, because a gap of three months or more needs a check-up
options.hg: Doctor ko dikhaye, kyunki teen mahine ya usse zyada ke gap ka check-up zaroori hai

explain.en: Periods that stop for three months or more should be evaluated. Someone else's medicines and crash diets can make things worse.
explain.hg: Teen mahine ya usse zyada periods band rahein toh check-up hona chahiye. Kisi aur ki medicines aur crash diets cheezein aur bigaad sakti hain.

q.en: Ananya is using a tampon and suddenly develops a high fever, vomiting and a rash. What should she do first?
q.hg: Ananya ne tampon lagaya hua hai aur use achanak tez bukhaar, ulti aur rash ho jaata hai. Use sabse pehle kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Take a fever tablet and sleep it off
options.hg: Bukhaar ki tablet lekar so jaye

options.en: Switch to a higher-absorbency tampon
options.hg: Zyada absorbency wala tampon laga le

options.en: Remove the tampon and get urgent medical care
options.hg: Tampon nikaale aur turant medical care le

options.en: Drink water and wait until morning
options.hg: Paani piye aur subah tak wait kare

explain.en: These are warning signs of toxic shock syndrome, which is rare but serious. The product must come out and she needs urgent care.
explain.hg: Yeh toxic shock syndrome ke warning signs hain, jo rare par serious hai. Product turant nikaalna aur urgent care lena zaroori hai.

q.en: Endometriosis is just a low tolerance for ordinary period cramps.
q.hg: Endometriosis ka matlab bas itna hai ki kisi mein ordinary cramps sehne ki capacity kam hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Endometriosis is a medical condition in which tissue similar to the uterus lining grows outside the uterus and causes inflammation and pain.
explain.hg: Endometriosis ek medical condition hai, jisme uterus ki lining jaisa tissue uterus ke bahar grow karta hai aur inflammation aur pain karta hai.
